title: REQ-20261111-OPS004 — Services Australia income support confirmation letter dated 9 Nov 2026: JobSeeker 31 continuous weeks (Tom Bradley)
content:
Summary of the Services Australia (Centrelink) income support confirmation letter supplied by Tom Bradley with his severe financial hardship application (specimen — demo only).

Issued by: Services Australia — Centrelink. Letter date: Monday 9 Nov 2026. Customer: Thomas (Tom) Bradley, DOB 19/08/1979, Customer Reference Number ending 412A (masked). Payment type: JobSeeker Payment. Payment start date: Monday 6 Apr 2026. Status on the letter date: current, paid fortnightly. Continuous period on the letter date: 31 weeks (6 Apr 2026 to 9 Nov 2026) with no breaks. Purpose stated on the letter: confirmation of income support for a superannuation fund.

Checks (Benefits & Eligibility; SIS reg 6.01(5)(a) and Caldova hardship policy HP-3):
• Eligible Commonwealth income support — JobSeeker Payment ✅
• Received continuously for at least 26 weeks — 31 weeks ✅
• Still being received when he applied — current ✅
• Letter dated within 21 days of Caldova receiving the application — 9 Nov to 11 Nov 2026 = 2 days ✅
• Name and date of birth match the member record for CS-1030412 ✅
• Document authenticity — no signs of alteration: consistent layout, reference-number format and dates ✅

Why this matters: fake or altered hardship documents are an AUSTRAC-listed indicator of super fraud, so Caldova checks the letter's details and dates against the member record. A letter older than 21 days is not grounds to decline — Caldova asks the member for a fresh letter. Combined with the statutory declaration and the overdue notices, this letter satisfies the income support part of the severe financial hardship test; the payment amount is still limited to $1,000–$10,000 gross, once in any 12-month period.
